shots.action: Rainwater beads and gathers on the glass of a bus window at night; beyond it, blurred city lights and dark building shapes slide steadily past from right to left. Droplets tremble, merge, and begin to trace wavering paths down the pane.

shots.action: The shot cuts to a closer view of the wet glass. A large droplet swells, breaks loose, and draws a clear line through the condensation; beyond it, streaks of amber and white city light smear across the dark background as the bus keeps moving.
